name: jsonfit-share-api
description: Lambda functions for JSON.fit share links (createShare, getShare)
comment: SAM reads the manifest from the CodeUri root, which is this directory (both functions build from src/ so they can share shared/shareLimits.js). Without this file 'sam build' prints 'package.json file not found' and installs nothing, leaving the bundle dependent on whatever AWS SDK the runtime happens to provide. The per-function package.json files are now vestigial.
